summary: Getaround, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the sale of its European business to GoMore ApS via a share purchase agreement. The transaction closed April 30, 2026, for ~€31.5 million in cash and a non-interest-bearing promissory note, with up to €2.3 million in potential additional consideration from French research tax credits. The sale was contingent on French labour council consultation and GoMore securing financing. Sellers provide customary indemnification with min/max thresholds that reduce promissory note principal. This divestiture follows the earlier wind-down of US operations. Watch for collection of tax credit receivables and any post-closing indemnity claims that adjust final proceeds.
